title: For Honor: Content of the Week - 23 April

author: Ubisoft
description: Warriors, it is your destiny to fight the legendary battles of Naoe the Swift, Yasuke the Brave, and Eivor Wolf-Kissed.
title: For Honor: Naoe, Yasuke and Eivor Hero Skins

author: Ubisoft
description:
Strive for vengeance with the Hero Skin of Naoe the Swift, a full body customization of the Shinobi.

Become an unstoppable legend with the Hero Skin of Yasuke the Brave, a full body customization of the Shugoki.

Dominate the battlefield with the Hero Skin of Eivor Wolf-Kissed, a full body customization of the Berserker.

The Executions Eivor's Ardor, Naoe’s Vengeance and Yasuke’s Oath are available for 10,000 Steel each until May 14th!

Don't miss the Jotunheim Frost Outfit for 15,000 Steel. Available until May 19th!

About For Honor:
Carve a path of destruction through the battlefield fighting for guts, glory, and survival in For Honor. Enter the chaos of a raging war as a Hero from some of the greatest warrior legacies ever known. For Honor is a fast-paced and immersive experience, mixing skill with visceral, never-before-seen melee combat.

Enjoy incredible seasonal content, engaging campaign and thrilling multiplayer with friends online, or solo against AI.

#Ubisoft #ForHonor
